issue_labels.label: missing comparative weighing of benefits and staffing costs

retrieved_principles.principle: Weigh a policy benefit against the opponent’s stated implementation cost.
retrieved_principles.failure_pattern: Benefits asserted without comparative weighing of staffing costs.
retrieved_principles.applicability: A policy debate with a concrete cost objection.
retrieved_principles.action_template: Name the benefit, answer the cost objection, and compare their importance.

specific_feedback.text: Compare the access benefit against staffing costs and explain why a limited trial is preferable.
